# OP-1 UI · SquareWave Studio

Draft original-OP-1 design kit; not a Teenage Engineering specification.
Start with ../skills/op1-design/SKILL.md, the source of the shared rules.

- README.md: quick start, components, preview and validation commands
- tokens/op1-ui.json: canonical nominal sizes, encoder palette and safe-area defaults
- docs/DESIGN.md: hierarchy, readability, controls and state
- docs/FONTS.md: private stock font acquisition, IDs, glyph checks and host metrics
- docs/GRAPHICS.md: native SVG subset, visibility, caches, smooth edges and CPU
- docs/COMPONENTS.md: APIs and framework adapter contracts
- docs/SOURCES.md: primary references, pins, attribution and evidence limits
- ../CONTRIBUTING.md and ../LICENSE: contribution and MIT terms

No TE code, fonts, glyph geometry or firmware is bundled. Stock-font fidelity
requires the user's local resource; schematic previews do not qualify it.

Original screen examples: docs/EXAMPLES.md
Stock resource observations and source limits: docs/STOCK.md
